description: This file is a shell script that defines a test suite for verifying the behavior of the 'git pack-objects' command, specifically focusing on delta chain length, depth limits, and pack construction. It includes creation of test content, running git commands, and verifying delta chain lengths under various configurations.

methods.name: max_chain
methods.description: A function that verifies the length of the delta chain in a given pack by invoking 'git index-pack --verify-stat-only' and parsing the output for 'chain length' information.
